title: Fix Panel Tree Drag Handles
description: Panel trees show a lonely drag handle at the top of the panel content (unlabeled PanelTreeUnit header under PanelDockProvider). Fix: (1) remove that false affordance for single unlabeled tree units; (2) every reorderable tree section and tree item must render its own DragHandle; (3) tree sections must support reordering with per-section handles. Root is in ui/js/react/index.tsx PanelTreeUnitsPane / TreeSection / TreeItem. Related closed tickets: REMOVE-PANEL-TREE-DRAG-ICONS (#2000), UNIVERSAL-DRAG-HANDLES (#2001).
summary: Removed the lonely unlabeled panel tree-unit drag handle (regression of #2000 under PanelDockProvider). Tree sections with 2+ siblings now show per-section DragHandles and reorder via TREE_SECTION_REORDER_MIME, with mergeTreeSectionOrder so plugin re-renders keep the user’s section order. Sortable TreeItems always render a drag handle. Wired sortableSections through PanelTreeUnitsPane and DeclarativeTreePanel.
